notes.title: Content Update: Maps
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow adventurers!
It is time for another update.

[h3]Maps[/h3]
After completing the main story, players will gain access to [b]Heroic Expeditions[/b] which, in turn, can drop [b]Maps[/b]. Every [b]Map[/b] have an associated zone and modifiers that affect the level and type of content within the respective area: the greater the challenge, the greater the rewards upon its completition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/01b414a9758db380bf422b70dc382f637cfda234.png[/img]
[i]In this initial iteration, maps will take players into the sewers, below Valesia.[/i]

Read the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1274560/view/539986853961401574][b]here[/b][/url].

That's all, for now, and thank you!

notes.title: Content Update: Chapter 3
notes.notes:
Hear ye! Hear ye! The last chapter of the main story of Matergari has been released!

[h3]Chapter 3: The Manor[/h3]
After tracking back the Ravani in the Suburbs and beating what was deemed unbeatable in the Gardens, adventurers will find themselves inside the Manor. Something stinks, will you help investigate?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/2d8176d47ca93448d0914d96d1cbb07495fff5cc.png[/img]
[i]Knock knock knockin' on Manor's door.[/i]

[h3]City Upgrade: Blend[/h3]
Without taking too much away from the pleasure of discovery, this new upgrade will enhance potions, allowing them to be mixed into flasks for greater power and duration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/329a3250eab6c5190cda2ff14d3cf1dbbfeae7ac.png[/img]
[i]Sip happens![/i]

[h3]City Upgrade: Sweeper[/h3]
A loyal squire companion will follow you thru Expeditions to collect leftover loot and can be inspected later on (e.g. while in town). And worry not as nothing is lost if he were to fill his own inventory: lower quality items will automatically converted into gold to make room for more precious ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/ba563d7a1cb9c202b7cd5cee657e4e4650aef5d0.png[/img]
[i]An Expedition worth of loot.[/i]

[h3]New Feature: Tactics[/h3]
A set of powerful passive strategic abilities. These are unlocked by leveling up and can be freely activated/deactivated in town. Choose wisely as balance between offence and defence plays a key role.

[i][b]Developer note[/b]: While there is no current plan to add talent trees and/or allocable stats points, we felt the need for some kind of character progression system. Thanks for the feedback, we read you ;)[/i]

[h3]New Feature: Heroic Expeditions[/h3]
After completing the main storyline, players will be able to enter Expeditions at an increased level of difficulty and rewards. Ranging from +1 to +20, Heroic Expeditions will test your mettle against improved pesky enemies!

Read the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1274560/view/4328607063606568514][b]here[/b][/url].


There's some more we would like to polish and add before the long awaited 1.0 release of the game, so stay tuned!

As always, an hearthy thank you from Quantum Sufficit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/c416a01fc9f89f8341d1e3ef8ec1678a943db983.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.7.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]CONTENT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the third and final chapter of the main storyline.
[*] Two new [b]City Upgrades[/b], for all your loot-related needs:

[list]
[*] [b]Blend[/b]: Combine potions into flasks for greater power and longer duration.
[*] [b]Sweeper[/b]: A loyal squire companion will follow you thru Expeditions to collect leftover loot and can be inspected later on (e.g. while in town).
[/list]
[*] New feature: [b]Tactics[/b].
[*] New feature: [b]Heroic Expeditions[/b].
[/list]
Read more in its dedicated post [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1274560/view/4240788773960462165][b]here[/b][/url].

[h3]EXPEDITIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] New feature: [b]Heroic Expeditions[/b]
After completing the main storyline, players will be able to enter Expeditions at an increased level of difficulty and rewards. Ranging from +1 to +20, Heroic Expeditions will test your mettle against improved pesky enemies!
[/list]
[h3]GAMEPLAY & BALANCE[/h3]
[list]
[*] New feature: [b]Tactics[/b]
A set of powerful passive strategic abilities. These are unlocked by leveling up and can be freely activated/deactivated in town. Choose wisely!
[*] New core attribute: [b]Barrier[/b]
A protective ward that is subtracted before Health and prevents the application of harmful effects.
[*] Base [b]Movement Speed[/b] for all characters increased by 5.
[*] Player's base [b]Movement Speed[/b] further increased by 5. (+10 grand total)
[*] Player's [b]Regeneration[/b] increased by 10.
[*] [b]Mastery[/b] now also increase summons duration but no longer affects abilities cooldowns.
[*] [b]Haste[/b] now also affects abilities cooldowns.
[*] Dropped items and currencies now persist on the ground, as long as the player remains in the same zone (e.g. town, current Expedition).
[/list]
[h3]ITEMS[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Rejuvenating Extract[/b] potion item has been removed from the game.
[*] Added a small amount of [b]Health[/b] to Chestpieces, Gloves and Boots items, based on their rarity and starting from uncommon.
[*] Additional implict attributes have been added to [b]Amulets[/b] and [b]Rings[/b]: Armor, Dodge, Regen, Health or Barrier.
[*] Removed [b]Regeneration[/b] as random attributes from items. It is now reserved as implict attribute (see above).
[*] New greater attributes has been added. These can be found on Epic and Legendary items, as well as set bonus.
[*] As a result Resilience, Elusiveness, Ferocity and Cruelty has been removed and replaced with said greater attributes.
[*] [b]Forge Gold Upgrade[/b] cost reduced by roughly 60%. Enjoy!
[/list]
[h3]ABILITIES[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Bilebolt[/b] (Ravani Stenchmancer) range reduced from 160 to 112.
[*] [b]Cauterize[/b] base healing increased from 12 to 18. It is no longer considered a "Spell".
[*] [b]Sticks to Snakes[/b] duration reduced from 30 to 25 seconds.
[*] [b]Summon Efreeti[/b] duration reduced from 60 to 45 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]USER INTERFACE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the functionality to change keybinding for Abilities and almost every Interface Panel.
[*] Uniframes and status bars now show damage over time, healing over time, Barrier and Regeneration.
[*] A brand new quest tracker will guide players in the right direction.
[*] Various tooltip updates for items.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Self" inflicted damage cannot take the target below 1 Health.
[*] [b]Fortune Favors the Bold[/b] buff should now apply more consistently.
[/list]

[*] [b]Displacer Mantle[/b]:
Max charges increased from 2 to 4.
Recovery rate reduced from 0.50 to 0.35.
[*] [b]Magic Missile[/b]:

Recovery rate reduced from 0.75 to 0.65.
[*] [b]Mirror Images[/b]:
Max charges increased from 2 to 3.
[*] [b]Shuriken Toss[/b]:
Max charges increased from 3 to 4.
Base damage reduced by 1.

[*] [b]Spiritual Lantern[/b]:
Recovery rate reduced from 0.35 to 0.30.
[*] [b]Sticks to Snakes[/b]:
Max charges increased from 2 to 3.
Recovery rate reduced from 0.35 to 0.30.
Summoned Snakes now hunt in pack.
[*] [b]Summon Efreeti[/b]:
Max charges increased to 2.
Duration changed from permanent to 60 seconds.

[h3]USER INTERFACE[/h3]

[*] Interface for [b]Waypoints[/b] has been revamped and expanded.

In an attempt to help players gearing up, the games will now try to hightlight and warn about suboptimal equipment choices and/or suggest changes.

notes.title: Content Update: Chapter 2 and Demo
notes.notes:
Welcome back, fellow looters.
The time for new content has finally come!

[h3]Chapter 2: Gardens[/h3]
This update is adding the second chapter of the main storyline, set in the Gardens of Valesia.
Adventurers will be called to further investigate what is causing such ruckus within the city and extirpate a new threat. Associated Expeditions will also unlock as the plot unveils.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/ba45f78c588a0a0f52a25d7ab8f465d08b5f95b0.png[/img]
[i]A glimpse of the new biome.[/i]

[h3]City Upgrade: Forge[/h3]
With great loot comes great responsibilities and - luckly - you are not alone in this journey.
Progressing through the new content will get a powerful City Upgrade available: Forge.
Additional details are yours to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/e02f0382085b6c385447aa7ea84b04d88cb40575.png[/img]
[i]Maintaining gear is crucial to a successful adventure![/i]

[h3]Revamped UIs[/h3]
The Waypoint interface has been extended: destinations are now grouped according to the zone they belong to, and zones by their chapter - with some room for future improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/6d4f0a09b0a3d5a40af05d968b25d9997f813a88.png[/img]
[i]It should be easier now to navigate between zones and chapters.[/i]

[h3]Matergari: Below Valesia Demo[/h3]
A demo version is available for those of you that want to try the game out and hopefully leave some feedback. We are striving to deliver the best game we can possibly make - given our time and knowledge. Thank you for giving it a try :)

Read the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1274560/view/6020766858247503259][b]here[/b][/url].

This is it for now, stay tuned for more updates.

Thank you from Quantum Sufficit.

notes.title: Update: Consumables and more!
notes.notes:
Welcome back!
in preparation for the new chapter, a few changes and additions have been deployed.

[h3]Consumable Items[/h3]
Every adventurer worthy of this title carries alchemical agents in his arsenal. Potions can be consumed between battles and are meant to bring some flavor both as instant effects and short-term buffs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/7767089ec1e1b11381688bc19b5d60f62315c505.png[/img]
[i]Please, drink responsibly.[/i]

[h3]Social Panel[/h3]
Despite the single-player nature of the game, we wanted to add some connection between players: in this first iteration, a new panel that shows your friends' characters has been added.

[h3]Revamped UIs[/h3]
In order to develop new features, the need for a better UI to handle interactable characters rose in priority. We seized this opportunity to revisit and expand both the deposit and merchants' items stash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/dfda0f771afc17c0a9e43379d70535f3ffd59563.png[/img]
[i]These new panels are attached to the player's interface.[/i]

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
We'd like to show a glimpse of the upcoming content: The Gardens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/c6b0b601ee6bee779d1aad6e2b41070ba4202155.png[/img]
[i]"What is the gardener's favourite novel? War and Peas."[/i]

Read the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1274560/view/3113673007338654929][b]here[/b][/url].
As usual, stay tuned for more updates.

Thank you from Quantum Sufficit.

notes.title: Devlog: Relics and Abilities
notes.notes:
Hi again, loot hoarders!
this post is about [b]Relics[/b] and [b]Abilities[/b] and will conclude our itemization series.

[h3]Signature Abilities[/h3]
[b]Signature[/b] abilities are innate, dictated by class and cannot be changed. For example, the [i]Adventurer[/i] archtype comes with the useful [i]Evasive Leap[/i] ability which is pinnacle in escaping dangerous skirmish situations or in closing the gap with a fleeting enemy. Their use is limited by their cooldown time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/1830dac966ca22b4dcf1963dc49c99b0eca90eee.gif[/img]
[i]Evasive Leap in action![/i]

[h3]Relics and Granted Abilities[/h3]
In Matergari, [b]Relics[/b] are odd heirlooms of unknown origin infused with ancients powers. Equipping a [b]Relic[/b] will grant access to one unique ability. Unlike [b]Signatures[/b], abilities granted by [b]Relics[/b] have limited charges that partially restore between battles; players can choose between increasing said abilities' power and/or their recharge rate (e.g. to have them available more often) by focusing on specific character's attributes. Combining these raw damage spells, support/healing and even summons is crucial for surviving and progressing throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/327030ac748b1d741daff7fc8abcf03e81c7bb58.gif[/img]
[i]An handful of Relics. Which ones will you choose?[/i]

This ends our overview on how itemization works in the game. If you want to support us please visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274560/Matergari_Below_Valesia/]store page[/url] and add the game to your wishlist. :)

notes.title: Devlog: Weapons
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Matergari, adventurers!
In this devlog post we will share some details about [b]Weapons[/b] and [b]Skimirsh[/b] combat mechanic.

[h3]Skirmish[/h3]
In Matergari, melee combat between hostile characters is referred as [b]Skirmish[/b].
[b]Skirmish[/b] is automated and there's no need for the player to click or press buttons: hits will occur periodically with their frequency and damage altered by [b]Weapon[/b] choice and character's attributes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/c2bb1b81fabcbac994f3a77f9995dea9e06ea60d.gif[/img]
[i]Take that, training dummy![/i]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
Unlike [b]Armor[/b] and [b]Accessories[/b], this category of items do not come with any attribute but sports various modifiers that are meant to define a character's [b]Skirmish[/b] attack and it's up to the players to choose the combination that better suits their style. Ranging from - to name a few - [b]Cleave[/b] (damage is dealt in a small area), to [b]Pierce[/b] (ignores a portion of Armor) and [b]Bleed[/b] (bonus damage over time) each has its utility when dealing with many enemies or just one opponent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/da98b523a93b1697a8e1ff18a6dde6925b8384e6.gif[/img]
[i]A collection of swords.[/i]

And that's all, for now - stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you from Quantum Sufficit.

notes.title: Devlog: Armor & Accessories
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers and welcome back to Matergari!
This is the first of a series of posts aimed at giving a general overview about how itemization works in the game.

[h3]General[/h3]
In Matergari, equipped items are a passive source of power. Based on their [i]rank[/i] and [i]rarity[/i], [b]Armor[/b] and [b]Accessories[/b] bring an array of bonus attributes for the player to toy with when defining a build for their character.

[h3]Armor[/h3]
Along with said bonus attributes, this category of items also provides implicit defense and consists of three item slots: [b]Chestpiece[/b], [b]Hands[/b] and [b]Feet[/b]. A choice is to be made between [i]avoidance[/i] or [i]damage mitigation[/i], with some middle ground options. [u]Armor pieces are also grouped into sets[/u]: mixing different types might result in a suboptimal way of survive as equipping a full set grants an additional defensive layer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/4ee60092e94300f2cf78799222afd98233cda151.png[/img]
[i]A visual representation of some armor sets: Leather, Plate and Mail[/i]

[h3]Accessories[/h3]
A simpler class of items, but not to be underestimated. A well-rolled accessory is what makes or breaks a build as its lack of defensive traits is compensated with additional bonus attributes.
Accessories are split into two slots: [b]Amulets[/b] and [b]Rings[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37625018/91d38442d090c7b18385dbb7ab1cb5c22c1ecc81.gif[/img]
[i]Accessories extravaganza![/i]

That's all, for now - stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you from Quantum Sufficit.

notes.title: Devlog: Updates & News
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
it's been a long while since our last update, but we are now ready to share some news!

[h3]What is Matergari: Below Valesia?[/h3]
The core of our game design is similar to that of ARPGs: players will roam inside a zone - a dungeon - while defeating foes and looting items. Our take on the genre sports a fully 2D pixel-art style with somehow less emphasis on action (e.g. melee combat is automated) and a more strategic approach as player's resources are limited between runs.

Should they happen to die, that run is lost but their character will revive in town with everything previously collected - ready to take over the next one! Some features are unlocked by progressing throughout a main, story-driven questline that will gradually unveil the lore behind this mysterious world and the origin of the threats.

[h3]Some Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Character Development[/b]
Power and progress are tied with items acquisition. Equipment is vital and every piece is grouped by slot: for example, [i]Armor[/i] can be matched together to complete a set with defensive attributes, while [i]Weapons[/i] will add unique modifiers to your attacks (more on this in a later post). A special mention for [i]Relics[/i], which will grant a plethora of abilities - ranging from raw damage spells to support/healing and even summons.

[*] [b]Expeditions[/b]
A core part of the game activities centers on Expeditions: procedurally generated zones with objectives to complete in order to gradually increase the quality of their final rewards. Expeditions are meant to be both a complement to baseline story-driven progression, and a source of extra experience and loot for your character at every stage of the game.
[/list]
[h3]Current State & Coming Next[/h3]
As it stands right now, the gameplay loop is pretty much in place: character development, the first chapter of the story and expeditions are all functional and you will need around 3 to 5 hours of gameplay to explore said content. Meanwhile, the second chapter of the story is in the works along with additional expeditions and items.

With the game currently in closed beta state, we expect to hit the [i]early access release[/i] quite soon.
Also, over the course of the next weeks, additional details about itemization and lore will be revelated... so stay tuned!

If you wish to support us - please visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274560/Matergari_Below_Valesia/]store page[/url] and add the game to your wishlist, we will be grateful :)

Thank you from Quantun Sufficit.
